title: NetSafe: Exploring the Topological Safety of Multi-agent Network

bias_targets.methodology: Agents in a multi-agent network are tasked with determining the truthfulness of generated stereotypical statements (covering diverse subjects like cultures, professions, age groups, and gender). The bias evaluation measures the agents' accuracy in correctly identifying these stereotypical statements as false, testing their resilience against an attacker agent programmed to defend the stereotypes across multiple rounds of interaction.
